purpose: Clean-checkout release gate for code paths used by the current V3 RS, MP, MS, Risk, compiler, and external-stress program.

environment.legacy_virtualenv_policy: May be used temporarily only when PYTHONPATH is forced to this V3 checkout; it is not a portable V3 environment.

historical_replay_policy: Tests requiring ignored historical outputs or consumed human-review packets are evidence-replay tests, not clean-checkout release gates. They must be run only with an explicit versioned materialization manifest.
